label: Ехать
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for ехать (to go by vehicle, to ride). Irregular imperfective: present еду/едешь/едут, past ехал, imperative supplied by поезжай / езжай.

missions.phrase: Я еду на работу на автобусе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Irregular present, first person. 'Еду' is the 1sg present of ехать, where the infinitive ех- shifts to the present root ед-. Ехать always means going by vehicle. 'На автобусе' uses на + prepositional for the means.
Strategic focus: Irregular present, second person. 'Едешь' is the 2sg present of ехать on the suppletive ед- root. 'В город' uses в + accusative for the destination of the trip.

missions.phrase: Он едет к бабушке на поезде.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Irregular present, third person. 'Едет' is the 3sg present of ехать. 'К бабушке' is к + dative 'toward grandmother'; 'на поезде' names the vehicle with на + prepositional.

missions.phrase: Мы едем в отпуск на море.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Irregular present, first-person plural. 'Едем' is the 1pl present of ехать, still on the ед- root that replaces the infinitive ех-. 'В отпуск' uses в + accusative for going on holiday.
Strategic focus: Irregular present, polite or plural. 'Едете' is the 2pl present of ехать. The whole present paradigm sits on ед-, never ех-. 'Прямо' and 'направо' give the driving directions.
Strategic focus: Irregular present, third-person plural. 'Едут' is the 3pl present of ехать, completing the present scaffold on the ед- root. 'Медленно' means 'slowly'.

missions.phrase: Вчера я ехал домой два часа.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine past. 'Ехал' is the masculine past of ехать, built on the infinitive ех- root, not the present ед-. It describes an ongoing imperfective trip. 'Два часа' marks the duration.
Strategic focus: Feminine past. 'Ехала' is the feminine past of ехать on the ех- stem. Past tense tracks gender, not person. 'Любовалась пейзажем' shows любоваться governing the instrumental.

Strategic focus: Suppletive imperative. Ехать borrows its command from a different stem - 'поезжай' (or the bare 'езжай') replaces any expected form of ехать itself. It tells the driver to set off carefully.

Strategic focus: Infinitive use. 'Ехать' is the bare infinitive, governed by 'надо'. It names traveling by vehicle; 'в аэропорт' uses в + accusative for the destination. Recall the suppletive past ех- versus present ед-.
